channel.title: AI-MarkDone - ChatGPT Reader, Markdown Copy, LaTeX, Bookmarks, Export
channel.description: A ChatGPT browser extension for Reader mode, source-aware Markdown copy, LaTeX formula copy/export, annotations, bookmarks, Google Drive backup, and Markdown/PDF/PNG export.

item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description: Toolbar does not appear Start with the simple checks: Make sure you are on the ChatGPT page. Refresh the ChatGPT tab. Open the browser extension manager and confirm AI-MarkDone is enabled. Check that the extension can access the current site. If ChatGPT has just loaded or updated, wait for the page to settle and check again. Copy or export looks wrong The final result also depends on the editor you paste into. Check it this way:

item.title: Sticky excerpts
item.description: Use this when You are reading a long answer and a few passages may matter, but you have not decided what to save, copy, or ask about yet.

item.title: Settings reference
item.description: Use this when You already know what AI-MarkDone can do and want to tune it to your habits.

item.title: Save ChatGPT answers with bookmarks and folders
item.description: What this solves Some answers are not ready to export immediately, but you know you will need them later. A browser bookmark saves the whole conversation, not the exact message.

item.title: Partial copy and Sticky have moved
item.description: Partial copy and Sticky excerpts each have their own guide:

item.title: Partial copy
item.description: Use this when You only need a small part of an answer, and you do not want code, tables, or formulas to break while copying.

item.title: Old directory entry note
item.description: Current status AI-MarkDone no longer exposes the old right-side directory rail. This page stays in place for older links only; it is not part of the current feature path.

item.title: Message navigation
item.description: Use this when You often read older answers inside a long ChatGPT thread. Once the thread gets long, scrolling becomes expensive. If you send a new prompt while reading, it is also easy to lose the exact spot you were using.

item.title: Install and refresh ChatGPT
item.description: What this solves AI-MarkDone installs in the browser and adds its toolbar to the ChatGPT page. After installation, the extension needs the current page to load again so it can recognize the conversation and message positions.

item.title: Import and export
item.description: Use this when You are reinstalling the browser, clearing extension data, moving to another device, or simply want a copy before reorganizing bookmarks.

item.title: Google Drive backup
item.description: Use this when Your bookmarks have become real working material, and you want a safer copy before reinstalling the browser, switching machines, or cleaning extension data.

item.title: Export ChatGPT to Markdown, PDF, PNG, or ZIP
item.description: What this solves Some answers need to leave ChatGPT: notes, shared documents, archives, or images. Each destination needs a different format.

item.title: Dynamic annotations
item.description: What this solves When asking ChatGPT to revise a long answer, “make it better” is usually too vague. You often know the exact sentence or paragraph that needs work.

item.title: Copy Markdown
item.description: What this solves ChatGPT’s built-in copy action is fine for a quick paste. It gets messy when the answer has formulas, tables, code blocks, or citation marks.

item.title: Copy ChatGPT formulas as LaTeX, MathML, PNG, or SVG
item.description: What this solves Formula copy is easy to get wrong. You may need LaTeX for notes, MathML for Office, or an image asset for slides and documents.

item.title: ChatGPT Reader mode in AI-MarkDone
item.description: What Reader does ChatGPT is good at answering. Long answers can feel cramped on the original page. Reader moves the current answer into a quieter panel, so you can stay with the text and read with fewer interruptions.

item.title: AI-MarkDone Plugin architecture
item.description: This map helps you understand how AI-MarkDone discovers ChatGPT content, prepares shared answer data, and lets Reader, copy, bookmarks, export, formulas, settings, and message navigation reuse the same workflow. If you are curious about a feature, or you hit a bug and want to understand why it happens, following the path can help you locate the layer involved. Drag, zoom, or open fullscreen; click a node to see what it does.

item.title: AI-MarkDone Manual
item.description: AI-MarkDone is a ChatGPT browser extension. It is built around the repeated pain points that show up in study, research, and work, with one direct goal: make ChatGPT dramatically more efficient to use.
